findings.body: Permit is an exported value type with per-instance spent bool. External callers can copy its value (copy := *permit) before activation, even with unexported fields, then Activate both original and © each passes owner/spent and consumes separate bool. This violates one-use/uncertain-result nonresend guarantee. Store consumption in shared private pointer state or coordinator-owned issuance registry so all aliases/copies share consumption.
findings.title: Copying Permit bypasses its one-use state
